sloka: स निरायुधमात्मानं यदा मेने महाबलः।मुष्टिभ्यां चरणाभ्यां च चकार कदनं महत् ।। ६.६७.१०९ ।।
transliteration: sa nirāyudhamātmānaṁ yadā mene mahābalaḥ।muṣṭibhyāṁ caraṇābhyāṁ ca cakāra kadanaṁ mahat ।। 6.67.109 ।।

translations.english: "He who is ready to face me, a rival of Lord of Death in conflict, with weapons in hand in great battle is worthy of honour to me."
